obligations.ask: Return confirmation that the annual review details are correct

results.segment: Confirmation that the annual review details are correct must be returned within 49 days of the date of this letter.
The annual review will be reviewed by our assessment team, and a decision is to be issued within 30 days.
This notice is issued for information and no reply is needed to it.
A further inspection falls due in 18 months and will be arranged by us.
